I am too old to carry heavy bags of fertilizer from the market, and we have always grown our yams and cassava without those chemicals. I put compost from our compound on the mounds because that is how my mother taught me to keep the soil good. My children and grandchildren will help with the weeding and harvesting, but I will hire young men for four days when it is time to dig the heavy tubers from the ground.
